latest_release.name: GestaltEdit v2.3.1
latest_release.body:
## What’s new

- Fixed the Watch setup sheet dismissing immediately on its first presentation.
- Added a native unsupported-system screen on iOS / iPadOS 26 and blocked on-device MobileGestalt access on unsupported systems. On-device editing requires iOS / iPadOS 27 or later.

## Download and signing

`GestaltEdit-v2.3.1-unsigned.ipa` is a local Release build, version **2.3.1 (14)**, containing the iPhone app and Watch helper.

Both apps carry **ad-hoc placeholder signatures with their App Group entitlements**. Re-sign both with suitable App Group-enabled profiles and preserve the embedded Watch app before installation. For Apple Watch signing and installation, see the community tool [WatchBridge](https://github.com/AdminZachary/WatchBridge), which is not affiliated with this project.

Release archive, preset/device-profile/backup/Watch/cache regression tests, signature verification and IPA integrity checks passed. The UI fixes have not been validated on physical devices.

detail.readme:
# GestaltEdit **A MobileGestalt utility that runs directly on iPhone and iPad**

Download IPA · Requirements · Install · 简体中文
Edit `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist` on-device. Capability presets, a full field editor, and backup/restore. > [!WARNING] > This app uses private APIs and modifies system cache data. Bad MobileGestalt values can break system features and may require restoring the device. Use only on devices you own. > [!IMPORTANT] > GestaltEdit is free and its source is public. Without authorization, you may not sell it. ## Features **Presets** — Organized by purpose: Siri AI, Dynamic Island, display, iPad features and everyday device features. iPadOS Mode includes multitasking, Stage Manager and iPad app support in one selection. Liquid Glass uses a single effects selector. Extended presets include HDR photos, AOD widgets/brightness, Audio Mix, FaceTime spatial audio, seven device regions. Options are filtered by system version. Siri AI retains supported device regions and adjusts known restricted device regions when needed; it does not change Apple Account region. Settings-page options and internal experiments are collapsed under Advanced; tap ⓘ for limitations where available. Capability overrides do not guarantee hardware or service support. Selections stage changes until Apply; removing a selection does not undo an already applied preset. Use Backups to restore prior values. On unsupported iOS 27 devices, Siri AI setup temporarily spoofs an eligible model. Face ID and dictation may be unavailable while spoofed. Finish downloading Siri AI models in Settings, then use **After Model Download · Remove Device Spoof** in Restore. After removing the spoof and restarting, Face ID and dictation work again; SiriMode = 2 and AI settings are retained. The ordinary pre-write backup keeps its original timestamp-based name and performs a full restore. **Field editor** — Search and edit any MobileGestalt key by hand when a preset doesn't cover it. **Backups** — Every write is backed up automatically. Back up, import, export, and restore at any time. ## Requirements - iOS / iPadOS 27.0 or later (iOS / iPadOS 26 is not supported for on-device MobileGestalt access) - Developer Mode enabled - A signing tool such as [iLoader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader) ## Install 1. Download `GestaltEdit.ipa` from [Releases](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit/releases/latest). 2. Install [iLoader](https://iloader.app/), connect your device, and sign in with your Apple ID (used only for local signing). 3. Import the IPA to sign and install it, then trust the certificate under Settings → General → VPN & Device Management. ## Apple Watch watchOS 26 is not supported. Expand the device connection row at the top of Tools and select the active Apple Watch paired with your iPhone. For Apple Watch support, we recommend signing with [WatchBridge](https://github.com/AdminZachary/WatchBridge). This community tool can enable Developer Mode and install an IPA containing both the iPhone app and the Watch app. It is not affiliated with this project. ## Credits - [Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) — presets and iPadOS support - [MGKeys](https://github.com/PoomSmart/MGKeys), [Erosion](https://github.com/jailbreakdotparty/Erosion), [mond](https://github.com/rooootdev/mond), [GestaltX](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) — capability mapping and preset references; see [catalog sources](docs/PRESET_SOURCES.md) - [FilzaSlop](https://github.com/0xjohnnydev/FilzaSlop), [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query), [0xJohnny](https://x.com/0xjohnny) — file access research - [neospring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) — respring implementation Not affiliated with Apple or the projects above. ## License [GNU General Public License v3.0 or later](LICENSE).
detail.readme_zh:
# GestaltEdit **直接在 iPhone 和 iPad 上运行的 MobileGestalt 工具**

下载 IPA · 系统要求 · 安装 · English
在设备上直接编辑 `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist`，提供功能预设、完整字段编辑器与备份 / 恢复。 > [!WARNING] > 本项目使用私有 API 并修改系统缓存数据。错误的取值可能破坏系统功能，严重时需要刷机恢复。请仅在你本人拥有的设备上使用。 > [!IMPORTANT] > 本项目免费、源码公开；未经授权，不得以任何形式出售本 App。 ## 功能 **预设** —— 按用途整理为 Siri AI、灵动岛、显示、iPad 功能与日常设备功能。iPad 模式一并开启多任务、台前调度和 iPad App 支持；液态玻璃使用单个效果选择器。补充 HDR 照片、息屏小组件与高亮、音频混音、FaceTime 空间音频、七个设备地区选项，并按系统版本筛选。Siri AI 保留受支持的设备地区，仅在已知受限地区按需调整，不更改 Apple 账户地区。硬件设置入口和内部实验功能收在「高级选项」中，有实际限制的项目可点 ⓘ 查看详情。能力开关不保证硬件或服务支持。选择后点「应用」才会写入；取消勾选不会撤销已经应用的修改，需要还原时请使用备份。 iOS 27 旧设备开启 Siri AI 时会先临时伪装为支持的机型。伪装期间面容 ID 和听写可能失效。请在设置中完成 Siri AI 模型下载，再到「恢复」使用「模型下载后 · 撤销机型伪装」，只恢复原设备身份，重启后面容 ID 和听写会恢复，并保留 SiriMode = 2 和 AI 配置。普通写入前备份继续按原来的时间格式命名，用于完整还原。 **字段编辑器** —— 预设没覆盖到的，可以自己搜索并编辑任意 MobileGestalt 键值。 **备份** —— 每次写入都会自动备份，也可随时手动备份、导入、导出与恢复。 ## 系统要求 - iOS / iPadOS 27.0 或更高版本（不支持 iOS / iPadOS 26 的设备端 MobileGestalt 访问） - 设备已开启开发者模式 - 一种签名安装方式，例如 [iLoader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader) ## 安装 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit/releases/latest) 下载 `GestaltEdit.ipa`。 2. 安装 [iLoader](https://iloader.app/)，连接设备并登录 Apple ID（仅用于本地签名）。 3. 导入 IPA 完成签名安装，然后在「设置」→「通用」→「VPN 与设备管理」中信任证书。 ## Apple Watch 暂不支持 watchOS 26。 在 Tools 顶部展开设备连接栏，选择当前与 iPhone 配对且启用的 Apple Watch。 如果需要使用 Apple Watch，签名建议使用 [WatchBridge](https://github.com/AdminZachary/WatchBridge)。这是一个社区工具，可以开启开发者模式，并安装包含 iPhone 端程序和 Watch 端程序的 IPA。它与此项目无关。 ## 致谢 - [Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) —— 预设与 iPadOS 支持 - [MGKeys](https://github.com/PoomSmart/MGKeys)、[Erosion](https://github.com/jailbreakdotparty/Erosion)、[mond](https://github.com/rooootdev/mond)、[GestaltX](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) —— 能力键值与预设参考，见[预设来源](docs/PRESET_SOURCES.md) - [FilzaSlop](https://github.com/0xjohnnydev/FilzaSlop)、[worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query)、[0xJohnny](https://x.com/0xjohnny) —— 文件访问研究 - [neospring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) —— 注销实现 与 Apple 及上述项目均无隶属关系。 ## 许可证 [GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版或更高版本](LICENSE)。
